'''Egan Hub Storage Header''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=31419|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Egan Hub storage facility, Louisiana to Texas Gas Transmission meter and regulating station, Louisiana.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=19502|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
